openTasks.title: Cosmetic cron drift risk at month boundaries
openTasks.detail: "*/2" on day-of-month resets each month rather than running a true period-2 cycle — odd-length months (31 days) can produce one back-to-back pair of episode days at a month boundary. Documented as cosmetic/non-urgent by the code's own comment; a KV-tracked "days since last episode" check would be the precise fix if it ever actually matters.
